newsitem.title: USA: Rochester Ginna nuke seen at 100 pct Weds.
newsitem.headline: Rochester Ginna nuke seen at 100 pct Weds.

text.p: Rochester Gas and Electric Corp's 470 megawatt Ginna nuclear power plant was expected to reach 100 percent power Wednesday after being taken off line late last week for repairs, a company spokesman said.
"We hope to be at full power today, but it takes time. There could be delays at certain stages (in the power ascension program)," spokesman George Lappan said Wednesday.
The plant, located at Ontario, N.Y., was taken off line late Friday for valve repairs.
According to the Nuclear Regulatory Commission's daily plant status report, the unit was producing at 55 percent of capacity and increasing power as of early Wednesday.
Ginna typically produces about half of the utility's power output.
